Enabling `OPENAI_REASONING_EFFORT` will now break image inference — see the inline finding. **Reviewed changes** - **Send reasoning effort for image inference** — `inferFromImage` now forwards `reasoning_effort: this.config.reasoningEffort`, matching `inferFromText` (`packages/shared/inference.ts:365`). - **Tests** — `makeConfig` gains a second `reasoningEffort` parameter, plus a `describe("OpenAIInferenceClient reasoning_effort")` block asserting the field is forwarded for text and image inference (`packages/shared/inference.test.ts:100`).   ｜ [Fix all ➔](https://pullfrog.com/trigger/karakeep-app/karakeep/3247?action=fix&review_id=5694988462) ｜ [Fix 👍s ➔](https://pullfrog.com/trigger/karakeep-app/karakeep/3247?action=fix-approved&review_id=5694988462) ｜ [View workflow run](https://github.com/karakeep-app/karakeep/actions/runs/40843998590/job/123346948556) ｜ Using `deepseek-v4.1-flash` (free via [Pullfrog for OSS](https://pullfrog.com/for-oss)) ｜ [𝕏](https://x.com/pullfrogai)

review_comments.body:
**Image tagging stops working** Setting `OPENAI_REASONING_EFFORT=low` for a reasoning text model now also sends `reasoning_effort` to the separately configured image model. The default image model, `gpt-4o-mini`, does not support this parameter, so previously working image-tagging requests fail with an unsupported-parameter error. Keep the setting usable for text-only reasoning setups, for example by allowing a separate image effort setting.
Prompt To Fix With AI `````markdown This is a comment left during a code review. Path: packages/shared/inference.ts Line: 365 Comment: **Image tagging stops working** Setting `OPENAI_REASONING_EFFORT=low` for a reasoning text model now also sends `reasoning_effort` to the separately configured image model. The default image model, `gpt-4o-mini`, does not support this parameter, so previously working image-tagging requests fail with an unsupported-parameter error. Keep the setting usable for text-only reasoning setups, for example by allowing a separate image effort setting. --- For each issue above, determine whether it is valid and should be fixed. If so, fix it directly. `````

```suggestion
        reasoning_effort: this.config.reasoningEffort, // only send for reasoning-capable models
```

The substantive finding: `inferFromImage` targets `this.config.imageModel`, which defaults to the non-reasoning `gpt-4o-mini` (`packages/shared/config.ts:87`) while the text default is a reasoning model. OpenAI's Chat Completions API rejects `reasoning_effort` on non-reasoning models with HTTP 400 (`Unsupported parameter: 'reasoning_effort' is not supported with this model`), so a user who enables `OPENAI_REASONING_EFFORT` for the text model will now have image tagging fail (`apps/workers/workers/inference/tagging.ts:174`) and LLM OCR silently fall through (`apps/workers/workers/assetPreprocessingWorker.ts:153` — its catch does not fall back to Tesseract). The attached one-line suggestion above is only illustrative; the real question is whether to gate the field on the target model's capability or document that enabling the setting requires a reasoning-capable `INFERENCE_IMAGE_MODEL`.   ｜ [View workflow run](https://github.com/karakeep-app/karakeep/actions/runs/40843998590/job/123346948556) ｜ via [Pullfrog](https://pullfrog.com) ｜ Using `deepseek-v4.1-flash` (free via [Pullfrog for OSS](https://pullfrog.com/for-oss)) ｜ [𝕏](https://x.com/pullfrogai)
